target.statement: WAND achieves mean ROC-AUC 0.777 (best mean Friedman rank 5.64) across 47 ADBench tabular datasets, at parity with 16 unsupervised baselines

compute.basis: Paper reports full 47-dataset WAND scoring in ~1.7 min single-CPU; the cost is downloading ADBench (up to n=619k, d=1555) and running 16 PyOD baselines with 5-min budgets and 3 seeds, plus reimplementing/validating the method from the repo.

blockers: Repo may not contain exact configs/scripts for the 47-dataset table
16 PyOD baselines with per-method budgets and 3 seeds add wall-clock
Large ADBench rows (donors 619k, census 299k) need download and memory care
title: Witnesses Explain Anomalies
